kuery.description: A KQL query string to filter results

showAgentless.description: When true, include agentless agents in the results

showInactive.description: When true, include inactive agents in the results

withMetrics.description: When true, include CPU and memory metrics in the response

showUpgradeable.description: When true, only return agents that are upgradeable

getStatusSummary.description: When true, return a summary of agent statuses in the response

searchAfter.description: JSON-encoded array of sort values for `search_after` pagination

openPit.description: When true, opens a new point-in-time for pagination

pitKeepAlive.description: Duration to keep the point-in-time alive, for example, `1m`
